scope: Read-only delta review of live-partial classification, invalid snapshots, content deduplication and existing five-model restore chain

findings.evidence: evidence_v3.py inspect lines394-415: active_pending identity error triggers the same helper unguarded in except; actual loop reproduced two helper calls, escaping ValueError and zero snapshots
findings.impact: Wrong live progress PID or duplicate ownership can make the whole inspection INVALID and discard its accepted-ID list instead of preserving the bad job snapshot and continuing
findings.fix: Separate v4 recheck_pending catches recheck exceptions, retains both errors and follows existing invalid snapshot path
findings.fix_verified: Actual v4 loop produced one immutable progress snapshot, kept other accepted fixture IDs, no escaping exception

reviewed_boundaries.live_partial: Exact job/repo/adapter argv owner remains pending, including finalization; never enters accepted records
reviewed_boundaries.failure_precedence: Existing failure*.json prevents live-pending classification; orphan partial remains invalid
reviewed_boundaries.immutable_snapshot: Observed bytes copied to fresh SHA-named snapshot; original and copied hashes plus any intervening change retained
reviewed_boundaries.failure_deduplication: Identity is original_path=actual_content_SHA, independent of inspection snapshot directory; changed content remains new evidence
reviewed_boundaries.accepted_model_backup_delta: Accepted IDs are a strict difference against verified ledger; duplicate/undeclared IDs and mixed checkpoint paths rejected
reviewed_boundaries.restore_chain: Previous receipt SHA, cohort manifest, receipt SHA and archive/member guards retained; reused Full models not repacked
reviewed_boundaries.guard_equivalence: accept_new, accept_full, terminal_checks, partition_identity, verify_archive, verified_ledger, row_from_result, summarize and validate_design AST unchanged across v2/v3/v4

limits.note: A matching PID only owns a pending output at inspection time; training health still requires separate measured round/log growth. Boundary fixtures are software checks, not scientific observations.
